meta.title: A PR line assigned to another buyer
gaps: Find and select a purchase requisition line whose assignee is a different buyer
Verify that the selected line's assignment, rather than another eligibility rule, caused Purchase Items to be blocked
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Find and select a purchase requisition line whose assignee is a different buyer; Verify that the selected line's assignment, rather than another eligibility rule, caused Purchase Items to be blocked

plan.title: PR line assigned to another buyer

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions screen required for this case.
Restrict the list to open requisitions that can potentially be sourced.
Select an available PR line; the catalog cannot target a line by assignee.
Check whether sourcing the selected line is refused, which would be the expected enforcement outcome if it is assigned to another buyer.
